sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Topics 3

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Topics 3:1
items.html: In the shattering of the vessels of Nekudim, inner vessels and posterior vessels are discerned there: for the seven kings that emerged in the smallness of Nekudim, by the looking of the eyes into the AHAP, which are the vessels KHB HGT up to the chest, which from the aspect of the lights are discerned as HGT NHY, are discerned as inner vessels, and are discerned as the essence of their very selves there, for they all emerged above the Parsa, and they are Atzilut from their root. And the aspect of the vessels from the chest and below, at the time of the smallness, received no light at all, because due to the sight of the eyes they went out beyond Atzilut and were diminished to BYA, below the Parsa; but only at the time of the greatness of Nekudim, by the MAN of the Vav and the point of the Yesod of AK in Aba and Ima of Nekudim, they returned and joined to the seven kings. Therefore the seven kings spread there also into BYA, up to the point of this world, as said in Part 7. They are called the posterior vessels of Nekudim.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Topics 3:2
items.html: (To the question) And the discernment between them is immense, for the inner vessels are, from their root, an aspect of complete Atzilut, as above; therefore they did not need to be shattered at all, and all their shattering was because, at the time of the greatness, they joined with the posterior vessels into a single Partzuf, since those vessels had already been diminished to the aspect of BYA. Therefore the inner vessels were also shattered, as said there. And hence, at the time of correction in the world of Atzilut, after the inner vessels returned and were clarified once again from their mixture with the posterior vessels, and rose and were corrected in Atzilut as before, at the time of the smallness of Nekudim, no diminishment will ever occur in them again. For this matter that was in Nekudim — namely, that the Parsa under Atzilut was nullified and the seven kings spread into BYA — will not occur again in Atzilut, for here the Parsa was corrected in a fixed manner, so that it will not be nullified even at the time of the coming of the Mochin of the Gadlut, as is known. Therefore they remain in Atzilut permanently. And they are the stature of HGT NHY of ZA, in which there is no diminishment ever. And the aspect of the point below the Yesod of ZA, which is the aspect of the Nukva of ZA, in which also no diminishment will ever occur, for she too is an aspect of an inner point, namely the Malchut of the inner vessels. Therefore her root is preserved in ZA forever. And it is known that, from the aspect of the vessels, this point is discerned as being below the chest of ZA, because from the aspect of the vessels the VAK, which are KHB HGT up to the chest, are discerned, and the point of the chest is the root of the Nukva. But from the aspect of the lights, in which the VAK are discerned as HGT NHY, the point is discerned as being below the Yesod. (Item 5).
